When someone replies Yarhamukallah to your sneeze
When boarding a vehicle or starting a journey

exercises.prompt: When would you say: "All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims."
exercises.explanation: Alhamdulillahi alladhi at’amana wa saqana wa ja’alana minal-muslimin (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ): All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims. Said when you finish eating.

source.text: Whoever eats food and says this dua, his previous sins will be forgiven.

options.text: When boarding a vehicle or starting a journey

exercises.prompt: When would you say: "In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live."
exercises.explanation: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya (بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا): In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live. Said when you go to sleep.

source.text: When the Prophet went to bed he would say: "In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live."

exercises.prompt: Your younger sibling breaks something of yours and you feel anger boiling inside. What should you say?
exercises.explanation: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil. (A’udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim). Said when anger flares - anger comes from the devil, and refuge is sought with Allah.

source.text: I know a word which, if he said it, his anger would go away: "I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil."

exercises.explanation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge. (Rabbi zidni ilma). A short Quranic dua for studying - knowledge is requested from its true Giver.

source.text: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
